data.name: Nastrond:Rhythm Shaker
data.detailed_description:
Nastrond: A Massive Renewal Towards Official Release

🍸 Nastrond: A Massive Renewal Towards Official Release

"Mix the rhythm, shake the spirit."

Hello, we are Red Clover, the development team building 'Nastrond,' the greatest bar in the Oasis.

We want to sincerely thank the regular patrons and new guests who visited our booth at 2026 PlayX4. Based on your warm support and honest tasting notes (feedback) shared at the event, we have undergone a massive renewal of Nastrond in preparation for our official release.

🍹 Major Changes in This Renewal

We have extensively polished the overall atmosphere and the tactile feel of the game, from the main menu to the rhythm gameplay.

  • Main Menu

We have introduced a new 3D background and completely revamped the overall UI design. We re-blended many elements to give you a more immersive and sophisticated first impression.

  • Scenario

We have expanded the previous story volume and significantly elevated the narrative quality. The character arcs and the worldbuilding have been refined to feel much deeper and more engaging.

  • Rhythm Gameplay

This is the biggest change. We made a bold transition from the existing horizontal layout to a vertical diagonal view.

We dramatically enhanced the visual presentation by framing the left and right character areas like comic panels, and added new gimmick multi-hit notes.

Furthermore, we integrated FMOD to meticulously refine the audio sync and groove.

Overall, it is a version that is easier on the eyes, offers a much more satisfying tactile feel, and makes it far more comfortable to lose yourself in the rhythm.

📌 Upcoming Roadmap

  • Fine-tuning the Main Menu UX/UI

  • Massively increasing scenario volume and further improving quality

  • Adding a large volume of new tracks

🎉 Official Release (Targeted for October 2026, schedule is subject to flexible adjustments)

This renewal is not just a simple update; it is a crucial step forward for Nastrond to grow one level higher toward its official release.

We still have a long way to go, but we will keep shaking our shakers so that you can feel that things have "definitely changed."

If you want to be the first to hear about Nastrond's official release, please add us to your Steam Wishlist. Your interest is our greatest driving force.

Mix the rhythm, shake the spirit.

by Nastrond Development Team, Red Clover


About the Game

"Shake up the flow, blend the rhythm."

This is the one and only absolute rule of Nastrond.

In the chaotic Middle World, there is a single neutral zone established by a diverse gathering of beings. They call it the 'Oasis'.
Nastrond is a bar nestled in the corner of an alley within the Oasis.
Beings from various dimensions visit this place to unfold their stories. They challenge the bartender to a rhythm duel—if they win, their drinks are on the house. But if the bartender wins, the cost of the drinks goes straight into the bartender’s tip jar.

■ The Oasis's Only Human Bartender, 'Ray'

You will take on the role of 'Ray', the only human in the Oasis and the newest bartender at Nastrond. By winning rhythm duels against the guests, you will earn the right to hear their stories.

"What am I supposed to do... from now on?"

The story begins after Ray follows 'The Master', the owner of Nastrond, and crosses over into the Middle World.
As of now, you do not know why she ended up in the Oasis, why she carries a bass guitar, or how she came to work as a bartender at Nastrond.

■ Become the Bartender of Nastrond!

Now that you are a bartender at Nastrond, you must welcome various guests, accept their rhythm duels, and start shaking.
Do not forget Nastrond's one and only absolute rule:

"Shake up the flow... blend the rhythm...!"

As Nastrond's bartender, you cannot back down from a guest's challenge.
When the LP starts spinning on the vintage record player, grab your shaker and ride the rhythm.

■ Resonate with the Shaker as the Notes Pour Down!

When the music starts, you must hit the falling notes with precise timing.
Experience the satisfying, crisp feedback—as if you were actually mixing a cocktail—within a familiar and intuitive keyboard-style rhythm game system.

As you strike the notes to the beat, the shaker will slowly begin to resonate. Once it reaches perfect resonance, a flawless cocktail is made.
The rhythm varies depending on the song and the guest, so you cannot let your guard down for a single moment. Never let the momentum break.

However, be warned that there may be 'traps' hidden among the falling notes. Filtering out the dissonance and picking only the true rhythm is the ultimate measure of a bartender's skill.

(Do not let the guest's momentum overwhelm you!)

(Shake the shaker perfectly to the rhythm!)

(A perfect rhythm draws out a powerful resonance from the shaker!)

■ Two Ways to Enjoy the Night at Nastrond

Nastrond offers two core game modes tailored to your playstyle.

  • [Scenario Mode]
    The main story content progressing from the perspective of 'Ray'. Win rhythm duels to serve a perfect glass, and listen to the private worries and wishes your fantasy guests confess as the drinks loosen their tongues. Enjoy an ever-deepening narrative served alongside your cocktails.

    (Main lobby - Story Mode selection screen)

  • [Arcade Mode]
    A mode for players who want to purely focus on the fun of the rhythm action. Freely select and play the charming tracks you've unlocked through the story, push your limits, and chase those high scores.

    (Story Mode - Episode selection screen)

■ Nastrond Continues to Grow

The following features will be introduced at official launch or through sequential post-launch updates:

  • [Arcade Mode Ranked System]
    Beyond simply enjoying the music, we plan to introduce a ranked system where you can compete against bartenders worldwide. Check the leaderboard to see who can mix the perfect cocktail.

  • [Gallery & Jukebox]
    We are preparing an event CG gallery and a jukebox so you can revisit the precious moments and music you encountered in the story whenever you want.

  • [Costume & Play Skin Customization]
    We are developing a feature that allows you to customize the outfits of Ray and her companions, as well as personalize note designs and hit effects to match your own style.

No one knows who will walk through the doors of Nastrond next.
Furthermore, no one knows what kind of stories 'Ray'—the Oasis's only human—will encounter, or what cocktails she will craft.

But one thing is certain: you are holding a shaker engraved with the Ouroboros symbol.
Now, shall we recite Nastrond's absolute rule one more time?

"Shake up the flow, blend the rhythm."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4330 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: intel uhd graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Controller support planned in a future update.
